notes.title: Avatars, Leaderboards & Achievements!
notes.content:
Hello fellow [b]Spinners[/b]!

First of all, I hope everyone is doing well considering the COVID-19 pandemic that is currently sweeping the world. Being cooped up inside the past few weeks has given me the motivation to create a small app update. Keep in mind, everything [b]is and always will be completely free[/b].

Let's dive right in!
[list][*]Two [b]new avatars[/b] have been added and can now be unlocked
[*]A new [b]quick restart[/b] feature has been added to right-click
[*][b]Weekly leaderboards[/b] have been added (they reset every Sunday night at midnight PST)
[*]The achievement requirements have been lowered from 1000 to 300
[*]New app icon
[*]The main menu looks better
[*]The total number of leaderboard entries is now displayed on the leaderboard screen
[*]'F' key now toggles fullscreen mode
[*][b]Arcade Mode[/b] now unlocks at level 2 instead of 3
[*][b]Fast Mode[/b] now unlocks at level 5 instead of 10
[*][b]Insane Mode[/b] now unlocks at level 10 instead of 15
[*]Minor bug fix to avoid visual pop when switching background
[*]Improvements to the level generator
[/list]

If anyone out there actually plays this game, give me a sign, or like, a high five emoji!

🙌(feel free to copy paste and comment below)
